searchText: Noob here, after sharding, is there any info on how p2p layer will work to defend against an attack? More specifically how will nodes discover and signal to nodes on different subnets that they need to now coordinate. What changes from the current situation with sharding? Won't there just be a lot more subnets than there are now?
